purpose: Train one shared bounded hip/knee/ankle proprioceptive first-contact actor using closed-loop Isaac physical returns, without candidate promotion
score: Mean per-lane reward: +1 for full-window clean-foot-only contact; +0.5 if first-contact bodies are feet only else -0.5; +0.2*clip(postcontact_x_speed,-1,3)/3; no contact -2; any root height <0.65 m rejects candidate
development_gate: Train clean-foot count >=7/15 and mean reward > baseline; do not inspect holdout until CEM candidate selection is frozen
holdout_gate: At least 4/8 clean-foot contacts, no physical fall, zero nonfinite state, independently audited bounded actions, then full 300-frame runs on all three seeds
failure_rule: If the development gate fails, retain frozen Parent and record the failed search; do not promote an actor or produce a claimed football demonstration
